governing_plan: .claude/learned_search_v02.md, 'MORPHEUS Downstream' Section 7 (v01 = the specification text); coordinator decision 2026-10-21 on the G18 Section 7 null
status: FROZEN before any blind finding arrives; canonical hash in dbench/protocols/assay_distillation_v02.sha256; a change is a new protocol id
implementation: dbench/downstream/distill.py (students, evaluation, diagnosis_7b, tcga_internal_detector); state-card fields distillation.primary_7a / diagnosis_7b / bulk_anchored_7c (dbench.downstream.locks.CARD_OPTIONAL)

7a_primary.students: ridge, 2-layer MLP (512, GELU, dropout 0.2), gated attention over region bags; trained on spatial discovery patients only, frozen H-Optimus-0 embeddings, state score as the only target
7a_primary.evaluation: Section 7.5: held-out spatial patients; TCGA-KIRC pooled, leave-one-site-out-calibrated and within-site-centred Spearman against the Section 5 bulk score; CPTAC against RNA and protein scores; baselines STPath and DeepSpot where run
7a_primary.success: best student TCGA pooled Spearman > 0.3 with patient-bootstrap CI above the permuted-target null q95, and within-site-centred Spearman above the available STPath / DeepSpot baselines

7b_diagnosis.role: run for every finding whether 7a passes or not, so a 7a null is interpretable; reported, never gated
7b_diagnosis.i_spot_level: Spearman between the ridge student's held-out predictions and the state score on held-out spatial patients (patient-grouped folds), with the permuted-target null; answers whether H&E predicts the state at all before any bulk reference enters
7b_diagnosis.ii_between_patient_share: share of the state score's spot variance carried by patient means in the spatial cohort (spot-weighted one-way decomposition), reported for the state as defined in the card; a state with a share near 0 has no patient-level quantity for a bulk proxy to track, which is a property of the finding, not a failure of the student
7b_diagnosis.iii_preparation_split: slide-cohort Spearman of the 7a ridge student split by preparation class: TCGA-KIRC diagnostic slides (DX, FFPE) as one class; CPTAC-CCRCC by the public CPTAC clinical field tumor_tissue_collection_frozen_with_oct (Yes / No). The CPTAC DICOM specimen-preparation sequence records staining only, so the clinical procurement field is the only public preparation label; this limitation is reported beside the split

7c_bulk_anchored.role: secondary, weaker claim: 'the state is detectable from H&E when a bulk label is available'; never a replacement for 7a and never called spatial-to-bulk transfer
7c_bulk_anchored.detector: ridge on slide-mean H-Optimus-0 embeddings trained inside TCGA-KIRC with the bulk molecular score as label (dbench.downstream.distill.tcga_internal_detector): repeated 5-fold CV (10 repeats, seed 20260824), leave-one-tissue-source-site-out, within-site-centred Spearman for both
7c_bulk_anchored.card_field: distillation.bulk_anchored_7c, written in a separate block from primary_7a

deepspot: inference deferred until the GPU is free after the registry freeze; launch script dbench/downstream/scripts/deepspot_inference.sh (Kidney_HEST1K, H-Optimus-0); the kidney model was trained on HEST data that includes the discovery cohort, so its discovery-cohort numbers are not independent and only its TCGA/CPTAC numbers stand as a baseline. The authors' precomputed TCGA predictions (huggingface nonchev/TCGA_virtual_spatial_transcriptomics, ratschlab/TCGA_virtual_spatial_transcriptomics_atlas) are gated and are not used
stpath: unavailable (input features from gated Prov-GigaPath, outside the H-Optimus-0-only rule)
gates: 7a success is the only declared success rule; 7b and 7c are reported, never gated

supersedes.what_changes: adds the pre-declared 7b diagnosis and 7c bulk-anchored secondary; 7a unchanged
